title: Multi-Provider Terminal Coding with LSP Diagnostics
oneLiner: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal user interface (TUI) with built-in Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics, allowing developers to switch LLM providers mid-session for code edits.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal user interface (TUI) with built-in Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics, allowing developers to switch LLM providers mid-session for code edits.
steps: Issue refactoring task and review LSP-verified diffs.
configSnippet: "Inspect LSP type errors across the workspace and refactor the API client types to resolve all warnings."
limitations: Plugin ecosystem is smaller than IDE extensions
terminal UI requires modern terminal emulator support.
